generalCriterionList.description: Single entity or Joint venture(maximum 2 members) is acceptable
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will not be accepted

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should quote exclusive of GST
Tenderer are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever
Should comply all the conditions as per the tender document
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees as per KPPP norms

itemList.description: PART A: Construction of HAAF (Hybrid Anaerobic-Aerobic-Floating wetlands) Technology Sewage Treatment Plant including Electro mechanical works at Aurad & Hallikhed-B ULBs of Bidar District, Yelburga ULB of Koppal District: Design, supply, construction, installation, testing & commissioning HAAF technology Sewage Treatment Plants at 1) Aurad ULB, 3.03 MLD capacity. Inlet Sewage parameters to be considered for design : As per CPHEEO Standards. a) Construction of RCC Bar Screen Chamber, Grit Chamber, Anaerobic Baffled Reactor,Aeration Tank, Floating wet land Tank and Chlorination Tank as per the drawings and as directed by Engineer in charge.ECOCORD: Supplying and fixing of required no of Ecocord frames of 45 mm Dia, White and green/ any suitable colour, Vinylon+Polypropylene Material, 0.18 Um/Div Roughness 12cN Fiber Strength & gt, 100N Single Fiber Strength, 90 Degree Material Contact Angle & It, 3000-5000 Specific Surface Area, 100 mm Installation Distance and 1200N Break Tensile Strength and other accessories complete with all lead and lifts. loading and unloading as per approved specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work. AERATION SYSTEMS: Supplying and fixing of Submersible Aeration system @ 2 Nos per MLD 4HP/ 400V/Hz Estd OTE upto 200kg/D, Bubble Size Micro Diffused. MOC suitable for Marine/Brackish water Propellor-SS316, Crank Case Marine Bronze, Back Flange Marine Bronze, Body SS304, Sacrificial Anode: Zn: Al Protection grade: IP68, Continuous operating System 24x7, loading and unloading as per specification, drawing and direction of engineer in charge of work. FLOATING GARDEN: Supply and Installation of HDPE Floating Wetlands for holding Aquatic plants with appropriate fixtures including specially designed bucket for maximum root development to enable nutrient removal in polluted water body including transportation to site and labour cost for assembly of fames, plants complete. Plants of different species for taking up nutrients from waterbody like Cannandica, Vetiver, Spider Lilly, Reed, Water Grass, Phragmites and other locally grown varieties in and around the waterbody. b) Construction of Admin room with toilet with necessary water supply facility as per drawing provided. c) Supply, Erection and Commissioning 11kV express feeder main, metering cubical,  etc, complete to proposed STP with allied  accessories / works. d) Providing LED Solar street lighting  to STP area on PSCC Pole - 9 Mtr Long, 300 Kg WL with all necessary accessories . e) Supply, fabrication, fixing and Testing of stainless steel (SS-316) Manual Coarse Bar screen with flat bar 50mm X 10mm, f) Supply, Erection and Commissioning of Flow Meter Electromagnetic Induction Bulk Flow Meters. g) Providing Precast Compond Wall - 2100 x 300 x 50 mm size h) Construction of un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement inside the STP premises using RMC M-30 grade for a minimum length of 220 mtr over granular sub-base and wet mix macadam . i) Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of OCEMS  along with other connected accessories j) Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 25 KWP MNRE approved Grid tied Solar Panels k) Chlorine Dosing System Chlorinator 200gms/Batch Production capacity. l) Providing and commissioing of  Bore well with minimum 5.0 HP submersible pump set along with necessary electrical accessories.

PART B :Construction of  CAMUS Technology Sewage Treatment Plant including Electro mechanical works at Kustagi ULB of Koppal District: a)  Design, supply, construction, installation, testing & commissioning of CAMUS technology Sewage Treatment Plants at Kustagi 3.56 MLD Inlet Sewage parameters to be considered for design :As per CPHEEO Standards. Main Units consisting of  PTU with Parabolic screen, Tube settler tank, qualization tank, Bio Mound-1, Sludge Drying Bed / Vermicompost bed, Collection tank-1,  Bed,Bio Mound-2, Treated water Collection Tank-2, Chlorine dosing unit with all necessary required media, catalyst, pumps, piping work , valves and flow meters etc as per the design requirements along with  approach road & pathways , pre-cast compound wall with gates, Admin Room, Bore well with submersible pumping machinery, solar powered LED yard lighting etc , complete on DBOT basis .The works comprises civil , plumbing , electro mechanical and instrumentation works , as per the relevant standards & specification in complete to achieve treated sewage standard  as per prevailing SBM-Urban 2.0 guidelines. b) Supply, Erection and Commissioning 11KVA express feeder main, Transformer, metering cubical, LT Panel, etc., complete to proposed STPs with allied accessories including approvals from ESCOMS. (under self-execution) along with all required allied works as per the requirements d) Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of   25KWP MNRE approved Grid tied Solar Panels with inverter, meter, cable etc. suitable for Rooftop installation as well as Utility Scale Solar Power Projects with 25 years of Linear Generation warranty. Work includes designing of solar panel area and MS frame and foundation on ground/roof of Pump house or CWR, showing arrangement of panel in available space, installation of PV module on MS frame as per approved design and drawings. Mounting structure shall be suitably designed to withstand wind velocity up to 150km/hr. Grid Tie Transformer less inverters, Multiple independent MPPTs, Peak efficiency of greater than 98%. Connect up to multiple strings PV arrays, Easy & fast connection, Built-in string-level monitoring, IP65 protection level, Wi-Fi / internet based remote monitoring with 5 years warranty. All cabling up to panel and meter, earthing etc. required accessories inclusive. The work shall be executed as per detailed technical specifications, approved drawing and direction of Engineer in Charge.
e) Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of OCEMS  along with other connected accessories to monitor inlet and Outlet Sewage parameters namely  PH, BOD, COD, TSS, Total phophorous, Total Nitrogen, communication interface enable with RS-485/RS-232/RJ45 ethernet port protocal should be modbus. vendor shoud provide modbus register for SCADA integration etc,.. along with Civil work complete.Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning of Online Continuous Effluent Monitoring System (OCEMS) for Sewage Treatment Plant Self-Surveillance in Compliance with CPCB Standards Excluding Flow Meter and including device with all accessories complete in all respect for real time data transmission to CPCB & SPCB.
e) Any other appurtenance / allied works applicable as per the site conditions and design requirements to be borne by the contractor. Note: 
 1) All works and items shall be executed as per the IS, CPHEEO, KSPCB & prevailing  Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban 2.0 guidelines and specifications 
 2) Work shall be carried out as per the approved designs, drawings, Specifications and As per the instructions of the engineer in charge. 3) Drawings enclosed are for tender purpose only.
